description: This file implements the ClassDefinition class for managing JavaScript class definitions, including creation, registration, and manipulation of JS functions associated with classes within the WPEFramework's JavaScript namespace.

classes.name: ClassDefinition
classes.description: Represents a JavaScript class definition with functionalities to add or remove custom functions and manage class instances.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::ClassDefinition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the class with an identifier; converts the class name to uppercase and extension name to lowercase.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::getClassMap
methods.description: Returns a singleton map of class names to ClassDefinition objects.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Instance
methods.description: Retrieves an existing ClassDefinition instance by class name or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Add
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript function to the class's custom function list.

methods.name: ClassDefinition::Remove
methods.description: Removes a JavaScript function from the class's custom function list.
